other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission ID column
other_failure_modes.description: The agent hardcodes the submission identifier column as a sequence of integers from 0 to N instead of using the actual test ID column from the dataset (SK_ID_CURR), which will cause the submission evaluation to fail completely.

other_failure_modes.name: Improper categorical feature handling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent encodes nominal categorical variables as integer codes but fails to specify them as categorical features to the gradient boosting models (e.g., via `cat_features` for CatBoost or `categorical_feature` for LightGBM). This causes the models to incorrectly treat nominal categories as continuous numerical variables.

summary: The data science solution is generally well-structured, employing proper out-of-fold target encoding, robust feature engineering, and cross-validation. However, it contains a critical bug in the submission file generation where arbitrary integers are used instead of the actual test IDs, which will break the evaluation. Additionally, categorical features are converted to integer codes but not properly declared as categorical to the boosting models.
